title: LinkedIn Company Employees Input
description: Pull public employee insights from any LinkedIn company page without a cookie or login. Paste company URLs and run.

companyUrls.title: Company URLs
companyUrls.description: List of LinkedIn company URLs whose people insights you want to scrape. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/', 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/openai/'. School and showcase pages are also accepted.

includeInsights.title: Include insights
includeInsights.description: Pull the public distributions LinkedIn renders for each company: where employees live, what they do, top skills, top schools. Useful for talent mapping and ABM segmentation.

includeFeaturedEmployees.title: Include featured employees
includeFeaturedEmployees.description: Pull any employee cards LinkedIn renders to anonymous visitors. Counts vary per company. Each entry ships name, title, location when present, and profile URL.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of companies processed in parallel. Higher concurrency runs faster but increases proxy and detection risk. Six is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
